instagram_title: Garment Dyed Tee — Why Thread and Rib Shade Can Differ from the Body
youtube_description:
Ever noticed the collar rib or the stitching thread looks slightly different in shade from the body of a garment-dyed t-shirt? In garment dyeing the whole sewn garment is dyed together, so polyester thread won't take the same shade as the cotton body. That's why 100% cotton or corespun thread is recommended, and labels are added after dyeing or dye-resistant labels are used so they stay legible. Confirm the thread type before you place your next order.
